profile.positioning: I’m building CompliAI, a next-generation RegTech platform leveraging advanced AI to automate and streamline regulatory compliance for fintechs. Having previously navigated the complex European regulatory landscape while scaling a pan-European payments business, I acutely understand the significant cost and resource burden compliance places on rapidly growing companies. CompliAI isn’t about simply *checking boxes*; it’s about embedding compliance directly into the product development lifecycle, reducing friction, and accelerating time-to-market. We focus on automating KYC/AML processes, transaction monitoring, and reporting requirements, specifically tailored to the unique challenges faced by early-stage fintechs. Our mission is to empower innovation by removing the compliance bottleneck. We’re targeting seed-stage to Series A fintechs operating in lending, payments, and digital asset spaces, offering a modular, API-first solution that integrates seamlessly with existing tech stacks. We’re currently running a closed beta with select partners and are rapidly expanding our AI model training dataset. We're not just automating tasks; we’re building a system that *learns* and adapts to evolving regulatory requirements.
profile.background:
